title: Rename the pane's slash command from /lore-pane to /lore for 0.13.0
description:
Operator instruction, 2026-10-03, first-party in opum-doc (seq 173, recorded on opum-agent OPAG-1089), relayed by opum-agent: "change 'lore-pane' to just 'lore' and 'quest-board' to just 'quest'." This task is lore-cli's half; quest-cli renames its own command.

opum-doc's design, which this builds to:
- The slash command becomes `/lore`. Argument forms carry over: `/lore full`.
- Internal pane ids, plugin `$.state` keys and `$.store` keys stay as they are, so saved settings survive. Only the registered command name and its `command.run` matcher change.
- It goes into 0.13.0 with LCLI-666. Delivered on LCLI-666's branch and PR by the orchestrator's explicit allowance ("one PR or a follow-up, your choice"); this record exists so the rename has its own acceptance criteria and provenance rather than riding unrecorded.
- Every doc, help string and release note that names `/lore-pane` as a command is updated. Prose that names the PANE ID `lore-pane` (which does not change) stays as it is.
- opum-doc measured `claude plugin validate` passing and 37/37 in a renamed test copy.

THE ONE UNMEASURED RISK, named by opum-doc: the opum-lore skill shares the bare name `lore`. Check the build in a live session for a command/skill clash and report it to opum-agent as an issue with evidence if one exists. Do NOT pick another name -- the name is the operator's.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The `/lore-pane` slash-command registration is dropped entirely, so no unreachable command is left behind, and the `lore` skill is the pane's entry point: `/lore dashboard`, `/lore dashboard full`, `/lore dashboard <doc-id>` and `/lore dashboard search <text>` reach `mcp__opum-lore__dashboard` (mapping to its `full`, `doc` and `query`), in plain words as well; every argument that does not start with `dashboard` goes to the CLI as today. The pane id, the `$.state` keys and the `pane-mode` store key are unchanged, so a choice saved before the rename still applies.

Every place naming `/lore-pane` as a command is updated: the module's registration and its description/help strings, its tests, and `docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md`. Prose that names the pane ID `lore-pane` (which does not change) is left alone, and the reference says which of the two moved.

The command-versus-skill name clash opum-doc named as the one unmeasured risk is measured in a live session and its result recorded on this task; if a clash exists it is reported to opum-agent with evidence rather than worked around or renamed.
`node scripts/mod-test.mjs`, `bun test` and `bun run lore check` pass on the head, with any pre-existing failure named as such.

implementationNotes:
CLASH MEASURED, 2026-10-03 -- the renamed command is UNREACHABLE while the opum-lore skill is loaded, and the skill is loaded in every session that has the plugin. Method: `claude -p --plugin-dir <clean git archive of the commit> "/<name>"`, one run per data point, cwd outside the tree.

EVIDENCE. Control, pre-rename tree `50b8dbc7`: `/lore-pane` answers as the COMMAND ("opum-lore: Lore pane opened."), and `/lore` answers as the SKILL. Renamed tree `8b680df8`: `/lore` answers as the skill, and `/lore full` also answers as the skill with "full" consumed as the skill's argument -- the command never answers under any form. NOT caught statically: `claude plugin validate --strict` passes on the renamed tree (it accepts a `lore` command beside a `lore` skill) and the mod's 49 tests pass; only a live session sees it.

CONSEQUENCE: AC position 1's premise -- that `/lore` and `/lore full` do what `/lore-pane` and `/lore-pane full` did -- is false as measured and cannot be satisfied by any change in this repository. Left UNCHECKED and UNAMENDED pending the decision, which is reported to opum-agent as an issue with evidence and a recommendation (opum-doc's own named risk, so it is theirs to settle). Per the instruction, no alternative name was chosen here.

DECISION, 2026-10-03 (opum-doc, relay ODOC-OP-2026-10-03-07 seq 176, read VERBATIM on opum-agent's OPAG-1089 at origin/dev `688d78ff` rather than taken from the relay): option A, refined, under constitution Article 5 clause 1 as amended. The pane's slash-command registration is DROPPED ENTIRELY -- no unreachable command is left behind -- and the `lore` skill becomes the pane's entry point: it routes the arguments `dashboard`, `pane` and `full`, and the plain phrase "lore dashboard", to `mcp__opum-lore__dashboard`; `full` maps to the tool's `full: true`; a concept id or search text after `dashboard` maps to `doc` or `query`; every other argument goes to the CLI as today. So `/lore dashboard` and `/lore full` open the pane through the skill, at the cost of one quick model turn.

AC position 1 is amended to that reachable form. The clash measurement recorded above is why: the renamed command could not be reached while the skill was loaded, and the decision drops it rather than leaving it as dead code. Delivered on LCLI-666's branch with LCLI-668, whose tool is now the pane's only entry point (opum-doc is updating the dashboard-tool design to say so).
